name: Heavenly Hair Oil
subtitle: Deep nourishment, light lamination, signature shine
shortDescription: A lightweight blend of organic oils that deeply nourishes, softens and adds healthy shine — especially to the ends.
longDescription: Our signature Heavenly Hair Oil is crafted with a luxurious blend of natural organic oils designed to transform dry, dull strands into glossy, touchably soft hair. Experience a light lamination effect that seals in moisture without weighing your hair down. Perfect for revitalizing split ends and adding a brilliant, healthy-looking shine to every strand.
